text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 1: coverage of the sum of the three farms beneath a bulk supply point. Dot: share of half- hours (daylight, 12 to 36 hours ahead, both nodes pooled, September 2025 to August 2026) with the observed sum at or below the forecast quantile. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole months. Dashed rule: nominal level. A dot to the right of the rule means the band is wider than it needs to be.'
text.tspan: Figure 1: coverage of the sum of the three farms beneath a bulk supply point. Dot: share of half-
hours (daylight, 12 to 36 hours ahead, both nodes pooled, September 2025 to August 2026) with the
observed sum at or below the forecast quantile. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole months.
Dashed rule: nominal level. A dot to the right of the rule means the band is wider than it needs to
